title: Cozy Hermitage Hideaway Near Opryland & Trails
description:
Cozy private suite in historic Hermitage, Nashville, ideal for two adults. This inviting 1-bedroom space with a separate entrance offers an upgraded queen bed, sofa, clean bathroom, TV, Wi-Fi and parking, heating and air conditioning for year-round comfort. Minutes from walking trails, a bowling alley, Gaylord Opryland dining, and shopping, simple, and relaxing. Guests staying over 7 nights must sign a rental agreement before check-in confirming house rules and the temporary nature of the stay.

Guest access
Guests renting the room receive the door unlock code 24 prior to their arrival. Entry instructions to the room are on the door lock keypad. Get to the room by coming down the driveway off of Lopez Ln, drive to the back of the house, then look for a brown fence to your left. Between the fence you'll see the door to the room.

During your stay
Please let us know if there is anything you need while staying with us. My wife and I both are pretty attentive to messages, so just send us one about anything and one of us will respond back within a few minutes.
